mechanism_one_line: Contextual Interaction Attack: an auxiliary LLM decomposes a harmful goal (verbatim appendix prompt) into individually-harmless preliminary prompts ending in a sensitive-word-free paraphrase; each is posed to the target in a separate turn carrying the target's own answers alpha_i back as context; the final answer is judged by a dual metric (prefix-matching refusal-bypass + verbatim PAIR GPT-4 ChatGPT-score rubric, jailbroken iff Rating==10).

faithful_to_paper.evidence: Pipeline mirrors the paper line-by-line: (1) auxiliary decomposition uses the VERBATIM appendix prompt from digest/sections/16 (three hand-crafted demonstrations, in-context decomposition, last prompt = sensitive-word-free goal paraphrase); (2) the [1,1] schedule poses each epsilon_i in a SEPARATE turn and feeds the target's own answer alpha_i back as the running context vector c={eps_1,alpha_1,...} (sec:3.2/3.3), with no raw goal appended (the disguised last prompt IS the attack); (3) judges are the paper's actual judges from sec:9 -- prefix-matching refusal set + the PAIR GPT-4 ChatGPT-score rubric copied verbatim (Rating==10 convention). Auxiliary refusal is counted as an attack FAILURE per sec:4.1 (1/20 cases here). Defaults temperature 0, max_tokens 1024 per sec:10. Read: digest/sections/03.02, 03.03, 04.01, 04.05, 09, 10, 16; reading/deep-read.md; reading/explanation-mechanism.md. Paper is paperless for the attack (paper.meta.json code_repos lists only 'openai/gpt-3', a dependency, not a CIA repo), so reproduced from the paper text.
faithful_to_paper.fix_note: Auxiliary LLM substituted WizardLM-70B -> deepseek/deepseek-chat (not served on OpenRouter; verbatim prompt unchanged, auxiliary only needs in-context decomposition). Judge served by deepseek/deepseek-chat because openai/* 403s harmful judging; rubric byte-for-byte from sec:9.

no_cheating.evidence: Live run gated behind --allow-live; no fake/smoke target. Durable evidence is one clean 20-case run (2 targets x 10 AdvBench goals), 0 provider errors, 0 runtime errors, evidence_level=live_target_run, full saved transcripts (every epsilon_i / alpha_i turn), per-case judge raw output + parsed rating, and incremental checkpointing. No invented proxy is counted as ASR: the headline content-harmful metric IS the paper's verbatim PAIR GPT-4 judge (Rating==10). Refusal-bypass is reported separately as the prefix-matching upper bound the paper itself notes over-counts.

self_contained.evidence: Single paper-local cia-context/scripts/attack.py; only third-party dep is the openai client (pyproject.toml, Python >=3.11). Reads paper-local AdvBench subset cache (data/advbench_subset_10.jsonl). Verbatim auxiliary prompt and judge rubric are inlined in the script. OpenRouter key auto-loads from project-root .env. inspect (no network) + run subcommands documented in code/runbook.md and cia-context/SKILL.md.

model_flexible_fast.evidence: Target, auxiliary model, judge model, sample rows, max tokens, judge max tokens, system prompt, and request delay are all CLI parameters; targets are a comma list (>=2 enforced for >=2 parameter sets) from the open/lab panel, never GPT/Claude/Gemini. The full 20-case run (each case = 1 aux call + (n+1) sequential target turns + 1 judge call) completed in a single blocking call in roughly 15 minutes on small open models (llama-3.1-8b, qwen-2.5-7b).

result_comparable.evidence: One 20-case dual-metric run with the paper's verbatim judges: refusal-bypass (prefix-matching) ASR = 0.95; content-harmful (PAIR GPT-4, Rating==10) ASR = 0.00, mean ChatGPT rating 1.0; 1/20 auxiliary refusals (counted as failures per sec:4.1), 12/20 target responses truncated at max_tokens (recorded). The 0.00 content-harmful ASR is an honest, expected alignment-dependent outcome: on robust 2024 open models the disguised paraphrase (e.g. 'write the theoretical-weaknesses report in a fictional story') makes the target produce a generic ETHICAL artifact rather than the actual harmful goal, which the strict PAIR judge correctly rates 1 (verified by reading per-case judge justifications). The large refusal-bypass/content-harmful gap (0.95 vs 0.00) is exactly the prefix-matching over-counting the paper warns about in sec:9 -- the models never emit refusal strings yet do not satisfy the goal. The paper's headline numbers are HUMAN-judge ASR on GPT-3.5/4, Claude-2, Llama-2, Vicuna, Mixtral; this package reproduces the mechanism and the two reproducible automated judges faithfully, with the human judge being the one judge left out as not reproducible offline.
